newsitem.title: SWEDEN: FORECAST-No Swedish repo rate cut seen Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-No Swedish repo rate cut seen Tuesday.

text.p: Sweden's central bank, the Riksbank, will not cut its key repurchase rate on Tuesday but the rate has still not bottomed out, a poll showed.

"I do think there will be more cuts ahead," said Tomas Pousette, analyst at Nordbanken. "Right now it is the weak currency development, the political announcements and worries about nuclear power that are in the way of a cut."
In 1996, the Riksbank cut the repo rate 25 times to 4.10 percent from 8.91 percent where it started in January.
So far there have been no cuts in 1997.
